name: long-heads-and-wide-floats-read
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): Reading step 2: heads longer than they need are read (key 0 as 1800 with value 1801 still satisfies when 0 1; 42 as 1b000000000000002a; key -1 as 3800 and -7 as 3806; bytes with a four-byte length); floats read at any width (45.5 as fa42360000, -90.25 as fbc056900000000000). Writing step 1 writes every head shortest and every float at the shortest exact width, so output is the canonical message of vector 01. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
